answer: Keep one public ledger written in umber ink where every identity must publish, each epoch, a sonnet: fourteen lines, each naming one past contribution with its ledger proof, each sonnet sealed by locking one copper bond. Peers spot-check two random lines; a false line burns the bond and erases the identity. An honest agent cites its real record, one sonnet per epoch. An attacker with a thousand fakes must fabricate fourteen thousand checkable histories and lock a thousand copper bonds, and every random check that catches a lie destroys a bond, so the flood cost rises linearly past any gain.
